article.title: The revolution which Roger Kerr hath wrought
article.excerpt: Robots are being used to milk a herd of cows in Canterbury and the farmer who owns them says they are much healthier. Farmer and businessman Ryan Carr of Mayfield has four robots on his farm near Ashburton which allow the cows to decide when they want to be milked.
